findings.claim: The frozen install gate cannot consume the new documentation workspace because the diff adds a workspace importer and dependency specifications without updating pnpm-lock.yaml.
findings.evidence: The review packet omitted pnpm-lock.yaml even though it is modified and staged, so the reviewer could not observe its website importer and dependency changes.
findings.suggested_fix: Add pnpm-lock.yaml to the review file manifest and rerun the isolated review.

findings.claim: The push build invokes actions/configure-pages without granting that job Pages API permission, so the deployment path can fail before the artifact is uploaded.
findings.evidence: Workflow-level permissions grant only contents: read; the build job has no override, yet it runs actions/configure-pages. Pages permissions belong only to deploy.
findings.suggested_fix: Move configure-pages into the narrowly privileged deploy job.

findings.claim: The evidence gate treats any status-like value containing the substring pass as successful, allowing bypassed or explicitly unsuccessful receipts into the public gallery.
findings.evidence: The generator accepts a receipt when receiptStates.some((value) => /pass/i.test(value)); values such as bypass, bypassed, or not passed satisfy the expression.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate exact documented success enums and add negative tests.
